XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic running shutdown, uneven and noisy engine with engine failure light and EPC on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0402 | SOLENOID VALVE | VALVE | ELECTRIC | EGR | RECIRCULATION | GAS | EXHAUST | IGNITION | ON | IGNITION | MIL | YELLOW |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: EGR solenoid valve

  • Fault: Engine fault light comes on whilst the vehicle is running normally

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0403 (EGR solenoid valve – Generic fault)

  • Cause: Faulty EGR solenoid valve

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the EGR solenoid valve and, if necessary, clean or replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The solenoid valve is located centrally above the valve cover, connected by a bracket near the windscreen wiper.
